About Faridabad Master Plan

Local property research | Project information | Buyer due diligence

What this website is for

Mr. Rajesh Ahuja

Faridabad Master Plan brings project pages, sector context, educational guides, videos and planning-related information together so buyers can make a more informed shortlist. It is a research and enquiry resource—not a government portal, developer website, legal service or guarantee of investment returns.

Background and approach

The site combines local real-estate context with a data-led approach to organizing information. Background and experience statements are publisher-provided context; buyers should still verify each property claim against official records and signed documents.

Sh. Daya Nand Banga

Family background shared by the publisher includes service connected with Faridabad Housing Board sectors. This is context about the people behind the site, not a substitute for property-specific verification.

Prince Banga

IT consultant and property-information publisher. The website uses a structured, data-oriented approach to present project details, buyer checklists and location research.

How to use this website

  • Compare project information and location context
  • Use checklists to prepare questions for sellers
  • Follow official RERA and authority records
  • Recheck prices, status and availability before booking

Editorial and verification approach

Project pages may include information from developers, official records and other published material. Those sources can change and may use promotional language. Where a claim affects a purchase decision—such as price, RERA status, possession, approvals, unit area, amenities or connectivity—check the latest primary document and get important commitments in writing.

We aim to distinguish project facts from developer claims and general guidance. This site does not guarantee that every listing is current, and it does not provide legal, tax or financial advice.
